boundary: The single Privacy label would be right if the leaked export held only ordinary contact or account data; because it is genotype data, whose disclosure is itself a health-information harm, gold adds Physical / Health.
factor: disclosure of health-category data (genetic/medical) where the data type itself triggers a second domain
note: The assessor stated the file is a genotype export but collapsed the health dimension into the same disclosure and gave one label; gold treats sensitive health data exposure as an additional direct domain.
